source: We found 130 products on Sephora ’s and Ulta ’s websites that use a sequential number system to label their shades.

source: Of those, 97% put their lighter shades, and thus the customers that use those shades, first.
claim: 126 of the 130 numbered product lines (96.9%) put a lighter shade first in their number sequence.

source: Yet only 4 out of those 130 products ordered their shades from dark to light.
